# superset_user (Data Source)

Looks up a user by its username, for example to reference its id in the `owners` of a dashboard or in `superset_group.users`. Usernames are unique; the lookup fails when no user has exactly that username. The users endpoint belongs to the Flask-AppBuilder security API, which Superset only enables with `FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_user" "analyst" {
  username = "analyst"
}

resource "superset_dashboard" "sales" {
  title  = "Sales"
  owners = [data.superset_user.analyst.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Username of the user. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `groups` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the groups the user is a member of, on Superset 6; null on versions without groups.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `roles` (List of Number) Identifiers of the roles of the user.
